caption: "Viva Cristo Rey!" The day after the feast of Christ the King, we remember Bl. Miguel Pro, a Mexican Jesuit who kept bringing the sacraments to people in secret and died forgiving his executioners. Meet more saints: catholicdoorway.com/saints #Catholic #Saints

image.title: Blessed Miguel Pro
image.body: A Jesuit priest who served Mexico's Catholics in secret and died with arms outstretched, crying “Viva Cristo Rey!”

caption: Advent begins this Sunday, November 29: four weeks of waiting and preparing for Christmas. Open a door each day on our Advent calendar: catholicdoorway.com/advent #Advent #Catholic
